research.title: Contra Costa County Library: PITS
research.question: Do the library's records fully show what happened, how incidents were classified, and what actions staff took?
research.summary: We're checking how the library records incidents, what staff guidance says, and which questions are still unanswered. The first batch of records is available to examine.

research.title: Healdsburg Police Department
research.question: What does the department require when someone asks an officer for their name or badge number?
research.summary: We're reviewing the department's identification policy and reported encounters. The facts and policy questions are being checked separately.

research.title: Edmond Police Department: Arrested, jailed, and vehicle impounded for alleged reckless driving in apparent violation of Oklahoma's sign-and-release statute
research.question: Why did the officer mark the defendant's signature line Jailed rather than obtain a promise to appear, and did the statutory release requirement apply?
research.summary: We're examining apparent noncompliance with Oklahoma's mandatory release procedure and serious potential Fourth Amendment violations involving the arrest, detention, and vehicle seizure.
research.wire: Incident-specific investigation; evidence privacy review and additional records pending
